ov: تفاحات فاسدة (الإنجليزية: Bad Apples) هو فلم كوميديا سوداء وإثارة أمريكي صدر عام 2025، أخرجه جوناتان إيتزلير، وكتبت جيس أوكين سيناريوه اقتباسًا من رواية السويدية: De Oönskade لراسموس ليندغرين، الصادرة عام 2020. يؤدي بطولة الفلم سيرشا رونان وإيدي والر ونيا براون ويعقوب أندرسون وراكي أيولا وروبرت إيمز وشون جيلدر وكيري هوارد. طُرح الفلم في دور السينما بالمملكة المتحدة والولايات المتحدة في 18 سبتمبر 2026، وتلقى مراجعات إيجابية من النقاد.
plotEn:
Maria Spencer is a Year 5 teacher at a primary school in Somerset, England. One of her students, Danny, perpetually disrupts her classes. Danny gets suspended after he pushes another pupil, the unsettling and sycophantic Pauline, down a flight of stairs, breaking her arm.
Maria visits Danny's father Josh, a delivery driver, who brushes off Maria's attempts to discuss about Danny. Maria finds Danny vandalizing cars, including her own, in a car park and, intervening, accidentally knocks him unconscious.
Maria drives Danny to a hospital, but when he threatens to report her for attacking him, despite her insistence that it was an accident, she panics and abruptly leaves with him, driving him to her house. Danny becomes destructive inside the house and enters the basement, where Maria locks him inside.
The next morning, Maria goes to work, and without Danny present, her class performs well during Ofsted inspections. Maria, in particular, receives praise for the improvement.
Maria continues to keep Danny confined. Discovering that he is unable to read and write, she begins tutoring him privately, furnishes the basement with video games and beanbag furniture, provides him with new clothes, and uses a harness, delivered by a distraught Josh, to keep him under control.
